candidates.name: Akamai Technologies
candidates.description: Both companies operate massive global edge networks providing integrated content delivery, DDoS mitigation, and cloud security services.
candidates.rationale: Akamai directly overlaps Cloudflare in CDN, edge networking, application security, and DDoS protection for the same enterprise infrastructure buyers.

candidates.name: Fastly, Inc.
candidates.description: Both provide edge cloud platforms that combine content delivery with programmable edge computing and web application security.
candidates.rationale: Fastly offers overlapping CDN, edge computing, performance, and web application security capabilities to the same infrastructure and security buyers.

candidates.name: Imperva
candidates.description: Both offer comprehensive web application firewalls and DDoS protection to secure enterprise digital assets.
candidates.rationale: Imperva overlaps Cloudflare in web application security, WAF, and DDoS protection, serving enterprise security and infrastructure buyers with the same protection needs.

candidates.name: Zscaler, Inc.
candidates.description: Both are leaders in cloud-native security, providing Zero Trust network access and secure web gateway services.
candidates.rationale: Both offer cloud-native Zero Trust networking and secure access products evaluated by enterprise security and network teams.

candidates.name: Netskope, Inc.
candidates.description: Both provide SASE architectures that unify cloud security, web security, and private access for distributed workforces.
candidates.rationale: Netskope and Cloudflare both offer SASE platforms combining secure web access, cloud security, and zero-trust private access for enterprise IT buyers.

candidates.name: Versa Networks
candidates.description: Both offer integrated SASE and SD-WAN solutions that combine networking and security at the edge.
candidates.rationale: Versa’s SASE, SD-WAN, and edge security platform overlaps Cloudflare’s network and security services for enterprise IT and security buyers.

candidates.name: f5
candidates.description: Both provide critical application delivery and security services, including WAF and bot management for enterprise environments.
candidates.rationale: F5 overlaps Cloudflare in enterprise application delivery and security, including WAF, DDoS protection, bot management, and application networking.

candidates.name: Palo Alto Networks
candidates.description: Both provide extensive cloud-delivered security platforms, including SASE and advanced threat protection for modern enterprises.
candidates.rationale: Both offer cloud-delivered SASE, Zero Trust, and threat-protection platforms evaluated by enterprise security and network teams.

candidates.name: Radware Ltd.
candidates.description: Both specialize in application and network security, with a strong focus on DDoS protection and web application firewalls.
candidates.rationale: Radware offers DDoS protection, web application firewalls, and application delivery services evaluated by the same security and network infrastructure buyers.

candidates.name: Barracuda Networks
candidates.description: Both offer cloud-based security suites that protect applications, email, and network infrastructure from modern cyber threats.
candidates.rationale: Both provide cloud-delivered application and network security, including web application protection, serving overlapping enterprise cybersecurity buyers.

candidates.name: Fortinet Inc.
candidates.description: Both provide integrated security and networking solutions, including SASE and edge security for global enterprises.
candidates.rationale: Fortinet overlaps Cloudflare in enterprise SASE, network security, zero-trust access, and edge protection, targeting the same security and networking buyers.

candidates.name: Gcore group
candidates.description: Both operate global edge networks that provide content delivery, cloud hosting, and integrated security services.
candidates.rationale: Gcore offers CDN, edge cloud, hosting, and security services that overlap Cloudflare’s core platform and target the same infrastructure buyers.

candidates.name: Bunny Optimizer
candidates.description: Both provide global edge platforms focused on high-performance content delivery and web acceleration.
candidates.rationale: Bunny.net offers CDN, edge delivery, and web acceleration services that overlap Cloudflare’s performance platform and target the same web infrastructure buyers.

candidates.name: Netscout Systems, Inc.
candidates.description: Both offer visibility and security solutions, including DDoS protection and network performance monitoring.
candidates.rationale: NETSCOUT overlaps Cloudflare in DDoS protection and network performance, serving the same enterprise network and security teams.

candidates.name: BlueCat
candidates.description: Both provide critical network infrastructure services, specifically focusing on DNS and IPAM security.
candidates.rationale: BlueCat’s enterprise DNS and DNS-security infrastructure overlaps Cloudflare’s core DNS and network-security offerings, targeting the same network and security teams.

candidates.name: KeyCDN
candidates.description: Both offer high-performance content delivery networks designed to accelerate web content globally.
candidates.rationale: KeyCDN’s core CDN service overlaps Cloudflare’s web performance offering and targets the same developers and infrastructure teams seeking global content acceleration.

candidates.name: Leaseweb Canada Inc.
candidates.description: Both provide global infrastructure services including CDN, cloud hosting, and dedicated server solutions.
candidates.rationale: Both sell global internet infrastructure and CDN services to IT teams seeking application delivery, performance, and cloud networking solutions.

candidates.name: armada.ai
candidates.description: Both focus on edge computing and connectivity solutions to solve complex data and networking challenges at the edge.
candidates.rationale: Armada delivers physical edge infrastructure and connectivity for remote operations; Cloudflare provides internet application security, networking, and developer services for web workloads.

candidates.name: Yotta Data Services Pvt Ltd.
candidates.description: Both provide integrated cloud, data center, and cybersecurity services for enterprise customers.
candidates.rationale: Yotta primarily sells data-center, cloud infrastructure, and managed services, not Cloudflare-like edge networking, CDN, and application-security infrastructure.

candidates.name: AhnLab, Inc.
candidates.description: Both offer AI-powered security platforms that protect cloud and network environments from sophisticated attacks.
candidates.rationale: AhnLab offers enterprise cloud and network security products overlapping Cloudflare’s security portfolio, targeting the same IT and security buyers.

candidates.name: SonicWall
candidates.description: Both provide cloud-delivered security services and network protection for distributed enterprise environments.
candidates.rationale: SonicWall offers network security, firewall, and cloud-delivered protection overlapping Cloudflare’s security and networking products for enterprise IT and security buyers.

candidates.name: Citrix Systems, Inc.
candidates.description: Both provide secure application delivery and networking solutions that enable remote work and cloud access.
candidates.rationale: Citrix primarily provides VDI and digital-workspace software, while Cloudflare centers on internet-edge security, CDN, networking, and developer infrastructure.

candidates.name: Cisco Systems
candidates.description: Both provide large-scale networking and security infrastructure, including SASE and cloud-based security services.
candidates.rationale: Cisco overlaps Cloudflare in enterprise networking, SASE, zero-trust, and cloud security, targeting the same IT and security buyers.

candidates.name: Vercel Inc.
candidates.description: Both provide developer-centric platforms for deploying and scaling web applications at the edge.
candidates.rationale: Both offer developer platforms for deploying, hosting, and scaling web applications using serverless and edge infrastructure.

candidates.name: DigitalOcean
candidates.description: Both provide cloud infrastructure services that simplify the deployment and scaling of web applications for developers.
candidates.rationale: DigitalOcean primarily provides cloud hosting and compute, while Cloudflare centers on edge security, networking, and performance; they are usually complementary layers.
